expressions.cue: All four buttons have the same design. Write the number of design kinds using 種類, not the object count. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: Four matching buttons represent 一種類 of design. 一種類 is いっしゅるい, not a statement that there is only one button.

expressions.cue: A menu offers strawberry, lemon and grape flavors. Write the number of flavor kinds using 種類. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 三種類 counts the three listed flavors, regardless of how many portions of each are available.
